method.countsFrom: evaluateLocality, evaluateRegionHub and evaluateGuide, called with the evaluation date. No count is read from publicationStatus.
method.workflowState: The eight-state derivation of editorial-workflow.ts, with the gate verdict in place of the stored publication flag.
method.guideEditorialState: GuideRecord carries no editorialStatus. A guide with no sections and no contentUpdatedAt is a candidate; a guide with either is a draft. No guide is placed in a review state, because no field on the record evidences a review.
method.restatement: Every count in this report is recomputed from the registries on each run, so a batch release, a withdrawal or a state change restates all of them together with the date above.

publishedPageCount.label: published page count: locality records plus guide records that pass the publication gate

candidates.label: A candidate is a typed, accounted-for record. It is not a published page and not a page in progress.

publishedStaticRoutes.label: Service, hub and company pages. Not one of them is a locality record or a guide record, and none is counted in the published page count.

excludedRoutes.label: Protected previews, and any other page that is not published content.

contentRouteTemplates.label: A template serves only the records the gate admits, so it is not a page count.

failures: Operational coverage is "unconfirmed"; publication requires confirmed coverage.
